business_problem: Leaseo needed to modernize property-management workflows with faster conversational support, lower AI operating costs, and a more scalable architecture than the fragmented mix of incumbent providers it had been relying on.
solution_summary: Leaseo rebuilt its property-management platform around Google Cloud so data, conversational AI, and operational analytics could share a single elastic foundation. Cloud Storage synchronizes operational data that is processed in real time with BigQuery and Cloud Spanner, while Google Kubernetes Engine provides burst-ready scalability for core application services. On top of that data layer, Leaseo uses Vertex AI, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini Live API, Gemini 3 Pro, and Google Enterprise CX to power AI Assist chatbot experiences, call summarization, conversational processing, translation, image enrichment from issues such as leaking taps, and service evaluation analytics. Looker Studio gives the business visibility into customer offerings and telemetry. The result is an infrastructure that supports low-latency AI interactions, real-time property workflows, and a future-proof foundation for the company’s next decade of product growth.

Leaseo's conversational and multimodal requests flow through Vertex AI and Gemini services, while results feed back into property-management workflows and are observed in Looker Studio dashboards.
